answers.goal: My ultimate goal in pursuing entertainment is to build up a successful career in social media and creating thoughtful and engaging content for the audience of creative projects. I want to develop my skills in content creation, branding, and digital marketing. I’d like to establish myself as a trusted and creative professional in social media industry.
answers.drew: Growing up, I always had a passion for film and all things related. I have multiple family members who work in the entertainment industry (Warner Brothers, Dream Works, Netflix, Titmouse) and I would love to follow in their footsteps. I’d love the opportunity to work behind the scenes on creative projects that test the boundaries of current film and television.
answers.seeking: I am very open minded and would love to get different perspectives from people working in the entertainment industry. I am open to finding likeminded creatives to potentially collaborate on projects together.
answers.inspiration: My biggest inspiration is Quentin Tarantino because he was able to build his own brand of film and his own distinctive style while branching from the traditional values of film and movies.
